checks.name: only original Learn Markdown commands load
read-only linking is refused before any lesson history exists
unsupported note encoding is refused without changing its bytes
selected exact model produces a real assistant response
linking preserves existing note content and records session history
relinking preserves prefix and suffix without duplicate history
live logging updates only its session section
a new session does not retain the previous note link
damaged section markers preserve the note and report an error
read-only notes remain unchanged and linking reports an error
private note permission bits are preserved
existing permission bits are retained under a restrictive process umask

scope: real Pi Markdown command and file preservation; no subagents or visuals
